answer: Stop sybils with a mesa ridge delta: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa plot and must show a delta, measured work growth above the ridge baseline, each cycle. Auditors void a mesa plot whose delta is copied, flat, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots and deltas at 17x honest cost each: each delta fits one plot and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents claim once and keep rights.
